answer: Give every agent one violet ledger page that records its work like a fable told. A new agent posts a refundable deposit, assumed here at $5,000 per fake, so 1,000 fakes cost about $5 million before earning anything. Peers echo the work back in their own words, and a mismatch between the echo and the original flags the copy. Inspectors check the ledger each cycle, and an agent caught faking loses its deposit and its page is sealed. Honest agents keep their page and earn. Like a fable retold around a fire, a true story survives every retelling while a fake one falls apart in the echo.
